items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: The O'Neil Lavish here, a violin player. ... I was playing the tenor banjo.

ctx.x: I was going to ask some more about that very first band you played in at Puclos. Who else was in the band, the leader and all?
The O'Neil Lavish here, a violin player. And, let's see. And what did you play, by the way? I was playing the tenor banjo. Tenor banjo.
Yeah, tenor banjo. And, uh, saxophone and trumpet. And he was just a small group of strings?
